caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a single handle, set against a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is two-toned, with the upper half in a yellowish-brown color and the lower half, including the base and handle, in a reddish-brown hue. The handle is rounded and attached at the upper neck and midsection of the pitcher. The rim of the pitcher is uneven, slightly chipped or worn, and curves outward. The pitcher rests on a surface with a wood-like texture and pattern. At the top of the image, the text "SMALL PITCHER EARLY 19th CENTURY" is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Creamer
